combo_label: The Sunday Roast × At the Funfair × James Bond

entries.clue: Adversary, of the sort 007 confronts in the final reel
Miss Lynd, and the cocktail he names in her honour
Little electric cars with rubber skirts, steered straight at your mates
Steam roundabout named for the bounding motion of its carved mounts
Firm behind the P99 pistol Pierce Brosnan's Bond adopts in Tomorrow Never Dies
Rubber diving gear unzipped to reveal an immaculate white jacket and carnation
Boxed stuffing-mix brand, its dried crumbs made up with hot water and shaped into balls
Pack of picture cards spread out to foretell what lies ahead
Wooden slab with a groove round its edge to catch the run-off as the meat is sliced
Pointed thermometer spike pushed into the thickest part of the meat
What the crystal-ball gazer in the little tent offers to tell
Work oil and salt into pork skin by hand before it goes in; 'Ay, there's the ___!'
Of beef, still red in the middle - and the opposite of common
